articles.title: Linus Torvalds Reveals Claude Code Wrote Linux Kernel Patches and Test Programs
articles.summary:
Linus Torvalds has disclosed that Claude Code helped write Linux kernel patches, test programs, review material, and the first draft of a technical write-up under his direction. The work targets page-cache read performance, showing how AI coding tools are used in core operating-system development while openly documenting technical limits. articles.title: Critical Adobe Acrobat Flaw Lets Malicious PDFs Trigger One-Click Memory Corruption
articles.summary:
Adobe has fixed a flaw in Acrobat and Acrobat Reader that lets a malicious PDF corrupt memory when a user opens it. Tracked as CVE-2026-81983, the out-of-bounds write carries a CVSS score of 7.8 and could lead to code execution with the victim’s user rights. Adobe says it has seen no active exploitation so far. articles.summary:
